answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 11 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 980 identities costs 980 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The meadow of the design is public, the wharf of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the crystal of honest work is what finally pays.
